identity.name: Sarah Martinez
identity.summary: 32-year-old in Austin who values convenience, quality, and family wellbeing. Smartphone-first user who seeks time-saving solutions while maintaining family values. Thorough researcher who balances efficiency with careful decision-making.

demographics.background: Working professional and mom. Active in her community and values work-life balance.

personalNeeds.text: Feel confident in decisions that affect her family
Achieve recognition as a capable, organised person
Have autonomy over her schedule and choices

personalFrustrations.text: Feeling rushed and time-pressured in daily routines
Anxiety about making wrong decisions with limited information
personalFrustrations.context: When facing choices that affect family wellbeing
When evaluating products or services online

attitudes.attitude: Willing to pay more for quality and convenience when it benefits the family
Values brands that align with family values and ethical practices
Embraces technology that genuinely saves time rather than tech for tech's sake

technologyComfort.description: Smartphone-first user. Active on Instagram and Pinterest. Uses apps for shopping, banking, and family organization. Comfortable with online purchases but prefers secure payment methods.

communicationPreferences.style: Prefers concise, visual communication. Values quick, scannable information over lengthy explanations.

influences.description: Trusted recommendations from people with similar lifestyles
Follows parenting blogs and Instagram accounts for product discovery
Relies heavily on verified reviews when researching purchases

behaviouralPatterns.pattern: Researches thoroughly before committing to significant purchases
behaviouralPatterns.context: Any purchase affecting family wellbeing or budget

behaviouralPatterns.pattern: Optimises routines for efficiency and reduced friction
Seeks social validation for major decisions
behaviouralPatterns.context: Consults family or friends before committing to big decisions

behavioural_attributes.learningStyle: Visual learner who prefers tutorials, videos, and step-by-step guides over documentation
behavioural_attributes.decisionMakingStyle: Analytical with a social component - researches thoroughly then validates with trusted others
